# QnALog 1.7.2

A simplification release for the API settings page and the service lists.

## Changed

- **API tab.** The API tab is now two cards, one for transcription and one for AI organizing, plus a collapsed Advanced settings section. Refreshing the model list or testing a connection updates only the card you used.
- **Shorter service lists.** Transcription shows OpenAI, Groq, Alibaba Cloud Bailian, SiliconFlow and Local/custom. AI organizing shows OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Alibaba Cloud Bailian, SiliconFlow and Local/custom. A service that is no longer listed but is already selected keeps working and is labelled as a legacy service.
- **AI organizing remembers each service.** The endpoint, key and model of each AI organizing service are stored separately, so switching services restores what you entered before.
- **Advanced settings.** Imported-audio speaker recognition and saved configurations moved into the collapsed Advanced settings section. Saved configurations can still be switched and deleted, but new ones can no longer be created.
- **Quick setup** offers Alibaba Cloud Bailian or OpenAI.
- **Home speaker row.** The speaker recognition status row on the home view is shown only when speaker recognition is enabled.
- **OpenAI quick-setup defaults** are updated to `gpt-transcribe` and `gpt-6-luna`, because the previous default models are scheduled for shutdown by OpenAI. Temperature is not sent for OpenAI reasoning models and Anthropic, and the language hint is not sent to `gpt-transcribe` on api.openai.com.
- Prices were removed from provider descriptions, a dead SiliconFlow documentation link was removed, and the data notice title was corrected.

## User impact

- The settings schema version is unchanged. No settings are dropped or changed by the upgrade.
- No need to reconfigure services or API keys.
- Downgrading to 1.7.1 drops the remembered settings of AI organizing services other than the one currently selected. The current service is unaffected.
- Existing notes, recordings and folders are not moved, rewritten or deleted by the upgrade.
